However we can try to search the template catalog for templates that, when applied to the product (aldehyde), give exactly those three precursors. Could search for templates that match the product with functional groups broken "carboxylic acid" etc. The search returned empty earlier, maybe because product SMILES is wrong. Let's try to get product SMILES by applying reduction to precursor? Actually we have precursors (esters). The product is the aldehyde after reduction. We can try to generate product SMILES by converting the carboxylic acid to aldehyde. But maybe the product also loses the protecting group? The precursors have protecting groups (silyl). The reduction likely does not affect protecting groups. So product SMILES should be same as precursor but with C(=O)O replaced by C=O. Let's generate product SMILES for each precursor.

Precursor 1: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"
Product 1: replace "C(=O)O" with "C=O". So "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"

Precursor 2: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"
Product 2: same replacement, also silyl on O after CO? Actually the silyl is on the O after CO. So product: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"

Precursor 3: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"
Here the silyl is attached to the O of the acid (ester). So product: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C=O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". This is different: the silyl remains attached to the aldehyde oxygen? That seems odd chemically but okay.

Thus product SMILES may vary. The template should work for all three? The template likely just reduces the carboxylic acid/ester to aldehyde, regardless of protecting groups.

We can try to search for templates that match any of these product SMILES with functional_groups_broken "carboxylic esters" or "aliphatic carboxylic acid".
